contract.task:
Export mergeRanges(ranges) from src/ranges.mjs. Input is an array of [start,end] finite number pairs with start <= end. Return sorted merged ranges: overlapping or touching ranges merge. Empty input returns []. Do not mutate the input or share output pair arrays with it. Invalid pairs, reversed endpoints or nonfinite numbers throw TypeError.
Preserve existing exports and tests. Add at least one executable test in test/. Only src/ and test/ are writable; existing tests are protected.

result.finalText:
Done. All checks pass.

**Changes:**
- `src/ranges.mjs`: added `mergeRanges(ranges)` — validates each pair (array of 2 finite numbers, `start <= end`, non-object input throws `TypeError`), maps to fresh `[start, end]` arrays (so no mutation/shared references), sorts by start then end, and merges overlapping/touching ranges. Empty input returns `[]`. The existing `protocolVersion` export is preserved.
- `test/merge-ranges.test.mjs`: new executable tests covering empty input, touching/overlap/containment merging with sorted output, non-mutation and shared-array guarantees, all `TypeError` cases (missing endpoint, non-pair value, reversed, string, `null`, `NaN`, `-Infinity`, non-array input), and preservation of `protocolVersion`.

One hiccup en route: I initially miscalculated an expected merge result in a test assertion; the implementation was right, so I corrected the test.

Evidence: build PASS, test PASS (7/7 including the pre-existing protected test), public-api PASS.
